sources.citation: Hueting, A. 1936. Iets over de spraakkunst van de Tobeloreesche taal. Bijdragen tot de Taal-, Land- en Volkenkunde van Nederlandsch-Indie 94: 295-407 (archive.org dli.ministry.10302 text).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: For Tobelo (Heleworuru dialect), Hoofdstuk III 'Klemtoon' pp. 324-325: 'I. De klemtoon valt op de voorlaatste lettergreep' with exceptions (final diphthongs/long vowels stressed; antepenult in words lengthened by a paragogic syllable; loans keep source stress; disyllabic suffixes attract stress to their penult). 'Tugutilsch' is mentioned only as an older dialect retaining s (consonants), not in the stress chapter. Not a statement about Tugutil.

sources.citation: Taha, Mujahid. 2016. Vokal Bahasa Togutil [Vowels in Togutil language]. Gramatika: Jurnal Ilmiah Kebahasaan dan Kesastraan 4(1): 59-64. Ternate: Kantor Bahasa Provinsi Maluku Utara. DOI 10.31813/gramatika/4.1.2016.49.59--64 (downloaded via the Internet Archive; journal host dead).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Describes an 8-vowel inventory (/a æ i ɛ e u o ɔ/) of Togutil as spoken in Dodaga/Tukur-Tukur/Titipa (Wasile Timur, East Halmahera); suprasegmentals mentioned only in a textbook definition; no word 'tekanan' anywhere. Phonetic transcriptions carry acute/grave/macron marks (e.g. /gùratí/, /úlu/, /maído/, /alú/) with no key, inconsistent, not usable as a stress statement. Cites an unpublished 2015 Kantor Bahasa report 'Fonologi Bahasa Togutil'.

sources.citation: Voorhoeve, C. L. 1988. The languages of the North Halmaheran stock. Papers in New Guinea Linguistics 26 (Pacific Linguistics A-76), 181-209.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: No stress statement. Sec. 2.4.3 (pp. 187-188): 'Togutil or Tugutil' is the local label for the three interior Tobelo variants (Lake Paca, Kukumutuk, Popon), distinguished only by consonant correspondences; Hueting's dictionary and grammar 'all dealing with the Heleworuru dialect'.
